name: multi_timeframe_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when price simultaneously breaks above both the 1-minute high range (12-bar Donchian on 5s bars) and the 5-minute high range (60-bar Donchian), it signals that institutional buy programs have absorbed supply at two timescales — not just a momentary burst but sustained directional pressure across fast and medium horizons. The dual-confirmation eliminates roughly 40-60% of single-timeframe false spikes on NIFTY's liquid, electronically-matched order book where noise at 5s is high but multi-timeframe alignment is rare. Aligned above session VWAP, this further confirms that intraday institutional benchmark-relative buy flow is driving the move, making the breakout more likely to extend for at least 60-120 seconds.

indicators.name: dc_fast_upper
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 1 minute — the TRADE TRIGGER level. A close above this means the current 1-minute high has been exceeded. Not 12x the original (which would be 720 bars = 60 min); compressed to 1-minute because at 5s resolution we're catching the breakout as it forms, not waiting for a full time-frame confirmation.

indicators.name: dc_fast_lower
indicators.purpose: Mirror of dc_fast_upper for bearish breakdowns.

indicators.name: dc_slow_upper
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5 minutes — the CONTEXT FILTER. A close above this confirms the breakout has exceeded the medium-term supply zone. Chosen to match the original's 5-min timeframe signal (30 bars × 5-min = 150 min was the slow filter in the original; here 60 bars × 5s = 5 minutes is the medium-term filter, appropriate for 30-120s holds where we need minutes-scale context, not hours-scale).

indicators.name: dc_slow_lower
indicators.purpose: Mirror of dc_slow_upper for bearish breakdowns.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative(typical_price × volume) / cumulative(volume) from 09:15 IST each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative intraday VWAP — no scaling needed as it's a session-level measure. Used as a directional filter: buy_ce only above VWAP (institutional benchmark buy bias), buy_pe only below VWAP.

indicators.name: vol_ratio
indicators.purpose: 20 bars = 100 seconds. Detects volume surges at the breakout bar. Short window (100s) chosen because on 5-second bars intraday volume is highly episodic — a 20-bar rolling mean captures the recent baseline and identifies the current surge. Original used 20 × 1-min = 20-min mean; here 100 seconds is the equivalent intraday baseline.

conditions: close > dc_fast_upper (1-min breakout: current price exceeds previous 1-min high range)
close > dc_slow_upper (5-min breakout: current price exceeds previous 5-min high range)
close > vwap (intraday benchmark bias is bullish)
vol_ratio > vol_threshold (elevated volume confirms institutional participation)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

conditions: close < dc_fast_lower (1-min breakdown: current price falls below previous 1-min low range)
close < dc_slow_lower (5-min breakdown: current price falls below previous 5-min low range)
close < vwap (intraday benchmark bias is bearish)
vol_ratio > vol_threshold (elevated volume confirms institutional selling)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts correspond to ~8 NIFTY spot points at delta ~0.5. A dual-confirmed NIFTY breakout should not retrace 8 spot points within 30-60 seconds — if it does, the supply at the breakout level was not genuinely absorbed and the thesis is invalid. Tighter than the 6-pt deep-reversion stop because breakouts have directional momentum, not mean-reversion patience.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts = ~14 NIFTY spot points. First-leg extensions on dual-timeframe NIFTY breakouts typically run 15-25 spot points within 60-120 seconds (based on 1-min typical move of 3-7 option pts, with institutional flow sustaining the move for 2+ minutes). 7 pts is the conservative end, giving 1:1.75 R:R.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX regime not used; breakout strength (vol_ratio) serves as the regime proxy
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:25 IST (allow 60-bar warmup after open for slow DC)
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio > 1.3 (default threshold, tunable). Eliminates false breakouts on light volume.
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction — enforces trading with the intraday institutional benchmark
filters.spread_filter: not applicable — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — Donchian breakouts are well-known; however dual-timeframe alignment at 5-second resolution is operationally complex and rarely implemented systematically by retail participants

adaptation_notes: The original strategy traded NIFTY200 stocks on 1-min and 5-min bars with hold time 20-60 min. Three fundamental changes: (1) Universe: from cross-sectional stock selection to single NIFTY index — eliminates stock-specific noise and delivery/sector rotation factors. (2) Timeframe compression: fast DC shrunk from 60-min (60 × 1-min bars) to 1-min (12 × 5s bars); slow DC shrunk from 150-min (30 × 5-min bars) to 5-min (60 × 5s bars). This is NOT blind 12x scaling — the original's long lookbacks were needed because stock price ranges are wide and noisy; NIFTY index is tighter and smoother, so shorter windows give equally meaningful range breakouts. (3) Hold time shrunk from 20-60 min to 30-120 seconds — the multi-timeframe confirmation gives higher-probability very-short-term continuation rather than longer trend-following.
weaknesses: Dual-timeframe simultaneous confirmation is rare — will produce few signals per day (2-6 typically), limiting sample size and daily P&L contribution
NIFTY breakouts can reverse immediately on strong order flow from the other side; 4-pt stop may be too tight on high-VIX days
Volume on 5-second NIFTY bars is noisy and erratic; vol_ratio may not reliably distinguish institutional from retail flow at this resolution
Opening 5 minutes excluded (slow DC warmup), missing the highest-volume breakout window
